NFL Teams Report Multiple Player Injuries

The San Francisco 49ers have placed defensive tackle C.J. West on the Injured Reserve list due to an injury. Separately, the Denver Broncos have provided updates on the injury status of players J.K. Dobbins, RJ Harvey, and Jonah Coleman.
